headline.zh: 用 Agent 构建企业应用原型
headline.en: Build enterprise app prototypes with agents

scenario.zh: 提供功能需求和业务规则，让 Agent 生成可运行的应用代码和架构方案
scenario.en: Provide feature requirements and business rules; agents generate runnable app code and architecture

instruction.zh: 选择要构建的应用类型
instruction.en: Choose the app type to build

output.zh: Agent 规划数据模型和核心流程
output.en: Agent plans data model and core flows

input.zh: 需要追踪仓库库存、入库出库记录、自动预警低库存商品、生成月度报表
input.en: Track warehouse inventory, log stock movements, auto-alert low stock items, generate monthly reports

output.zh: 数据库：商品表、库存表、出入库记录表；核心模块：库存查询、库存变更、预警规则引擎、报表生成器；技术栈：PostgreSQL + Node.js + React
output.en: Database: products, inventory, transactions; Core modules: query, updates, alert engine, report generator; Stack: PostgreSQL + Node.js + React

output.zh: Agent 设计流程状态和权限
output.en: Agent designs flow states and permissions

input.zh: 员工提交请假、报销、采购申请，经理审批，财务复核，自动通知结果
input.en: Staff submit leave, expense, purchase requests; manager approves; finance reviews; auto-notify results

output.zh: 工作流引擎：待提交、待审批、已通过、已拒绝四状态；角色权限：员工、经理、财务；通知模块：邮件和站内消息；建议状态机模式
output.en: Workflow engine: pending, review, approved, rejected; Roles: staff, manager, finance; Notifications: email and in-app; Use state machine pattern

instruction.zh: 选择要查看的代码部分

output.zh: Agent 生成表结构和索引
output.en: Agent generates table structure and indexes

input.zh: 为库存管理系统生成 PostgreSQL 数据表
input.en: Generate PostgreSQL tables for inventory system

output.zh: CREATE TABLE products (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(200)); CREATE TABLE inventory (product_id INT, quantity INT);
output.en: CREATE TABLE products (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(200)); CREATE TABLE inventory (product_id INT, quantity INT);

output.zh: Agent 生成 REST 路由代码

input.zh: 生成库存查询和更新的 Node.js API
input.en: Generate Node.js API for inventory query and update

output.zh: app.get('/api/inventory/:sku', async (req, res) => { const result = await db.query('SELECT * FROM inventory'); res.json(result); });
output.en: app.get('/api/inventory/:sku', async (req, res) => { const result = await db.query('SELECT * FROM inventory'); res.json(result); });

instruction.zh: 确认架构和代码是否符合需求
instruction.en: Confirm architecture and code meet requirements

output.zh: 可在 Blitzy 平台继续完善

takeaway.zh: 示例展示了需求到架构和代码骨架的生成过程；实际开发、测试、部署流程需在 Blitzy 平台完成
takeaway.en: Example shows requirements to architecture and code scaffold generation; actual development, testing, and deployment happen on Blitzy platform
